_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/casting/test_cast_adventure_from_graveyard.py. t_afg_hildi is Hildibrand Manderville's shape: an adventurer whose death grants 'you may cast it from your graveyard as an Adventure until the end of your next turn' (grant_playable with as_adventure). t_afg_rise is its Adventure, an instant that gains 3 life so the resolution is observable without a token. t_afg_plain is the near miss written without as_adventure, which grants the creature face. t_afg_kill is the removal that makes either of them die.
